Part 1: Merge specimens from other museum datasets into Bulbul_AVONET_data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

#My bulbul dataset
bulbuls <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv")
str(bulbuls)
#Florida Museum of Natural History (FLMNH) dataset
flmnh <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_oac.xlsx")
str(flmnh)
#UPLB Museum of Natural History (UPLB) dataset - Phillipines
uplb <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_uplb_philippines.xlsx")
str(uplb)
#Only keep row 34 and beyond
uplb <- uplb[34:nrow(uplb), ]
#SYSU Guangzhou dataset - China
sysu <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_SYSU_China.xlsx")
str(sysu)
#Steinhardt MNH - Israel
steinhardt <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Steinhardt_NihanD_Israel.xlsx")
str(steinhardt)
#Field data 1: Wenyi Zhou's field data from China
field1 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Wenyi_Zhou_China.xlsx")
str(unique(field1$sp.latin))
# Remove duplicate columns if they exist
field1 <- field1[, !duplicated(colnames(field1))]
field1 <- field1 |>
  filter(sp.latin %in% c(
    "Pycnonotus sinensis",
    "Spizixos semitorques",
    "Hemixos castanonotus",
    "Ixos mcclellandii",
    "Hypsipetes leucocephalus"
  ))
str(field1)
#Field data 2: Peter Mikula and Martin Hromada's field data from Angola
field2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Mikula-Hromada_Sample data sheet.xlsx")
str(field2)
field2 <- field2 |>
  filter(Family == "Pycnonotidae")
str(field2)
#LSUMNS bulbul data: David Vander Pluym
lsumns <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulbul_Vander_Pluym.xlsx")
str(lsumns)
lsumns$KD <- lsumns$Wing_Chord - lsumns$Sec_1
#Museum data from Peter Mikula (measured by Martin Bulla) - National Museum, Prague, Czechia
nmpc <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulla&Mikula_bulbuls_NMP_export.xlsx")
str(nmpc)
nmpc$KD <- nmpc$Wing_Chord - nmpc$Sec_1
#Cambridge University Museum of Zoology (CUMZ) dataset - UK (part measured by Carla only, Elizabeth yet to be added)
cumz <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample data sheet CJD.xlsx")
str(cumz)
cumz$KD <- cumz$Wing_Chord - cumz$Sec_1
#UMICH initial dataset - Probst
umich <- read.csv("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_UMICH_Probst.csv")
str(umich)
umich$KD <- umich$Wing.length - umich$First.secondary.length
#NMNH dataset - Manila, Philippines
nmnh <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_NMNH_Philippines.xlsx")
str(nmnh)
nmnh$Bill_Width <- as.numeric(nmnh$Bill_Width)
nmnh$Bill_Depth <- as.numeric(nmnh$Bill_Depth)
nmnh$Tarsus_Length <- as.numeric(nmnh$Tarsus_Length)
#Universitas Andalas dataset - Indonesia
ua <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_UA_Muhammad.xlsx")
str(ua)
#Kansas University Natural History Museum (KUNHM) dataset - Camila Mendes and 1 more colleague
ku <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_KU_CamilaMendes.xlsx")
str(ku)
#Royal Ontario Museum (ROM) dataset - Vedant Gattani
rom <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_ROM_Vedant.xlsx")
str(rom)
rom$KD <- rom$Wing_Chord - rom$Sec_1

ua <- ua |>
  rename(
    AviList = Scientific_Name,
    Beak.Length_Culmen = Bill_TotalCulmen,
    Beak.Length_Nares = Bill_FromNostril,
    Beak.Width = Bill_Width,
    Beak.Depth = Bill_Depth,
    Gape_Width = Gape.Width,
    Tarsus.Length = Tarsus_Length,
    Kipps.Distance = `Kipp's_Distance`,
    Wing.Length = Wing_Chord,
    Tail.Length = Tail_Length
  )

traits <- c(
"Beak.Length_Culmen",
"Beak.Length_Nares",
"Beak.Width",
"Beak.Depth",
"Tarsus.Length",
"Wing.Length",
"Kipps.Distance",
"Tail.Length",
"Gape_Width"
)

#AVONET means for each trait, by species
avonet_means <- bulbuls |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(traits), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)),
    .groups="drop"
  )
avonet_points <- merge(
  bulbuls,
  avonet_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_specimen","_mean")
)

#Museum means for each trait, by species
ua_means <- ua |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(traits), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)),
    .groups="drop"
  )
ua_points <- merge(
  ua,
  avonet_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_ua","_mean")
)

comparison <- merge(
  avonet_means,
  sysu_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_AVONET","_SYSU")
)

#Non-highlighted species mean plots
comparison_long <- comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -AviList,
    names_to = c("Trait", "Dataset"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(AVONET|SYSU)",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Dataset,
    values_from = Value
  )

ggplot(comparison_long,
       aes(AVONET, SYSU)) +

  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#009E73") +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Trait, scales = "free") +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    x = "AVONET species mean",
    y = "SYSU species mean"
  )


#Method 2: Highlighting species with specimen measurements in the SYSU dataset, and comparing those to the AVONET means for those species
ua_species <- ua_points %>%
    filter(!is.na(Wing.Length_ua)) %>%
    pull(AviList) %>%
    unique()

avonet_points_filtered <- avonet_points %>%
    dplyr::filter(AviList %in% ua_species)

avonet_long <- avonet_points_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_specimen"),
    names_to = "Trait",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_specimen",
    values_to = "specimen"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_mean"),
    names_to = "Trait_mean",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_mean",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  filter(Trait == Trait_mean) %>%
  select(AviList, Trait, specimen, mean)

ua_long <- ua_points %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_ua"),
    names_to = "Trait",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_ua",
    values_to = "ua"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_mean"),
    names_to = "Trait_mean",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_mean",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  filter(Trait == Trait_mean) %>%
  select(AviList, Trait, ua, mean)

ggplot() +

  geom_point(
    data = avonet_long,
    aes(mean, specimen, colour = AviList),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = ua_long,
    aes(mean, ua),
    colour = "#D55E00",
    shape = 17,
    size = 1
  ) +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Trait, scales = "free") +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +

  labs(
    x = "AVONET species mean",
    y = "Specimen measurement"
  )

ggsave("../results/Collaborator data comparisons/ua_comparison_Muhammad.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)


#Checking for specimens that are > 3 standard deviations from the AVONET mean for that species, for any trait

avonet_stats <- bulbuls |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    culmen_mean = mean(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm=TRUE),
    culmen_sd = sd(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

florida_check <- merge(
  flmnh,
  avonet_stats,
  by="AviList"
)

florida_check$outlier <-
abs(florida_check$Beak.Length_Culmen - florida_check$culmen_mean) >
2*florida_check$culmen_sd


```
